cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've found our wedding video. Shall we watch it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your father's speech. We never could agree what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant exactly this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paused. Let's skip to the dancing, then. No speeches. You can help me settle whether your uncle actually falls into the cake.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Leave that letter under my plate. We only just managed breakfast together again. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I've covered this month's rent. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let me open it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please finish breakfast with me first. Yesterday you finally unpacked; I can't risk you packing again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The missing savings are a banking complication. Please keep our anniversary reservation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ring the bank, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me handle the complication. I'd like us still sharing a table when the money arrives.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every evening. There, your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every evening. There, your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're selling the sofa but keeping my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If someone offered twenty pounds, would you still keep it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Could you take the price sticker off before I sit?

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just us for lunch. That disastrous family reunion did us a favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We learned an audience makes us compete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter just asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. We're already applying what we learned; nobody has to storm out to get a turn.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.
